# proxmox_node_ceph_cmd_safety (Data Source)

Checks whether a Ceph service action is safe through `GET /nodes/{node}/ceph/cmd-safety`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_ceph_cmd_safety" "stop" {
  node    = "pve"
  service = "osd"
  action  = "stop"
  name    = "0"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `node` (String)
- `service` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `safe` (Boolean)
- `status` (String)
